variants.name: 观察样本
variants.recipe: Duplicate the landscape cutout with different crops in a three-frame contact sheet; replace the title with an observation, not a fake publication headline.

variants.name: 页边批注
variants.recipe: Use annotation-sheet.svg as a source of freehand marks; inline the SVG and retain only the one mark that clarifies the argument.

usage.remix: Build an argument with a primary headline, one paper clipping and a contrasting note. Keep overlaps intentional and let annotations point to a real narrative detail.
usage.avoid: Do not imply these original vector mountains are documentary photographs. Avoid tiny body text or unlicensed magazine/newspaper scans.
usage.motion: 0–1.5s: headline and clipping arrive with different angles; 1.7–2.5s: note lands; 2.6–3.7s: red circle reveals. Hold long enough to read.
usage.portrait: Put masthead and title first, clipping below with a smaller note overlapping its bottom edge. Preserve at least 40px between reading text and the illustration.
usage.captions: Reserve an uncluttered caption band. Recompose labels rather than obscuring subtitles. Preview footer labels are not subtitles.
